title: Founder one-shot
does: Offers a funded founder the thing their open engineering post is hiring for: a built component, a page, a video and a short email sequence. For engineering studios and agencies selling to startups.

fazio.when: the user says run it like Fazio: his public method; course lessons only from the user's own private copy

hormozi.when: offer design is the weak point: value, guarantee, pricing, lead channels

max.when: cold outbound and video structure, as in Max Forbang's ocp.wiki

stages.task: Write the one offer: one buyer, one outcome, a date, and a guarantee marked as a proposal the owner can honour.
Write the target gate and where to look for founders who pass it.
Write the one-page copy for this founder.
Write the video script for this founder.
Write the email sequence for this founder.

quotes.text: Funded within 90 days, 1-200 staff, the post names the work, the post text is saved whole. Fail any and stop.
The offer is one thing. A menu of services is the failure this playbook exists to avoid.
Value = (Dream Outcome × Perceived Likelihood of Achievement) ÷ (Time Delay × Effort & Sacrifice)
A message that would still make sense sent to someone else is not personal enough.
A cold buyer is offered one specific result with the risk moved off them.
